title: Brothers in Arms, Partners in Healing: A Story about a Breakthrough in Treating Post-Traumatic Stress
gist: Podcast notes: a Marine veteran and a fellow veteran describe recovery from post-traumatic stress using Magnetic e-Resonance Therapy (MeRT), a synchronized transcranial magnetic stimulation approach supplied by Wave; the text is brief and carries a medical disclaimer.

insights.claim: Marine veteran Jeff Lindquist reports reclaiming his life from post-traumatic stress after losing fellow Marines in Iraq, using Magnetic e-Resonance Therapy (MeRT) based on synchronized transcranial magnetic stimulation.
insights.speaker: Jeff Lindquist, Erik Won, and Ryan Evans
insights.so_what: Anecdotal; indicates veteran-led interest in neurotech treatments for PTSD, not clinical evidence.

insights.claim: The episode says Wave supplies MeRT to licensed clinics, and Jeff Lindquist and Erik Won began a mission to help others with post-traumatic stress after his recovery.
insights.speaker: Jeff Lindquist, Erik Won, and Ryan Evans
insights.so_what: Wave is a commercial supplier of MeRT; promotional framing, treat with caution.

source_meta.author: Jeff Lindquist, Erik Won, and Ryan Evans
